> **As of 2026-10-29.** Wintermute Hub (ssh alias `hub`) is a permanent Hetzner cx33 in fsn1 (4 shared vCPU, 8 GB, 80 GB; public 178.105.64.66, tailnet 100.66.158.49). It is the fleet's NATS hub, runs the system Caddy and the Docker demo apps, and builds nothing. "Wintermute" is the Hermes agent (Joe 09-10 ruling: the agent is "Wintermute", the box stays "Wintermute Hub"); since 10-26 the agent runs on carbon, not here (Joe 10-26 9:5x PM "wintermute/hermes runs on carbon now"). Live truth: Hetzner Fleet inventory (10-07 plus 10-23 edits) and ssh from a seat; there is no fleet-dash block for hub (UNVERIFIED).
